source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Matthew’s two named visitors and stated purpose without importing spices.
key_decisions.before: After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
key_decisions.after: After the Sabbath, as the first day of the week was dawning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now after the Sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves passive raised and the invitation to inspect the empty place.
key_decisions.before: He is not here, because he has been raised, just as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.
key_decisions.after: He is not here; he has been raised, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He is not here, for he has been raised, just as he said. Come, see the place where he lay.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the narrator’s report without implying agreement by every Jewish person.
key_decisions.before: The soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been spread among Jews to this day.
key_decisions.after: The soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. This story has circulated among the Jews to this day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So they took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been spread among the Judeans to this day.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders distazō as hesitation while retaining the tension alongside worship.
key_decisions.before: When they saw him, they bowed before him, but some doubted.
key_decisions.after: When they saw him, they worshiped him, but some hesitated.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps disciple-making central, all nations, singular name, and the threefold baptismal expression.
key_decisions.before: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.after: So go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves obedience-oriented teaching, continuing presence, and the age rather than the world’s destruction.

key_decisions.after: and teaching them to keep everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you every day, to the end of the age.”
